t: You're looking at a sculpted bust of Adrian Shooter, here in Marylebone station. Shooter was a British transport executive, and the bust depicts him, which is why it stands in a railway station. It was made by Luke Perry, an English artist known for monumental sculptures, especially ones celebrating under-represented peoples and the industrial heritage of the Black Country. Perry directs the non-profit company Industrial Heritage Stronghold. Shooter lived from 1948 to 2022.
